text: “Friends,” said our guide. “Nobody in the pavilion, Daddy Jacques?” “I ought not to allow anybody to enter, Monsieur Robert, but of course the order does not apply to you. These gentlemen of justice have seen everything there is to be seen, and made enough drawings, and drawn up enough reports—” “Excuse me, Monsieur Jacques, one question before anything else,” said Rouletabille. “What is it, young man? If I can answer it—” “Did your mistress wear her hair in bands, that evening?
